subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should non-internal room_event turns keep strict message-tool-only visible delivery while using a session-stable prompt/cache contract, or should explicit groupChat.visibleReplies automatic change room-event delivery itself?
rationale: Current docs and tests intentionally keep ambient room events quiet, but the report and linked PR show that coupling that strict effective mode into prompt-facing sections has real cache and instruction-stability costs.

options.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
options.body: Keep room_event final text private by default, but pass a stable prompt-facing mode through all prompt, queue, and tool-list paths so cacheable prefixes do not churn.

options.title: Honor Automatic For Room Events
options.body: Let explicit groupChat.visibleReplies automatic make room_event final text visible, with docs and tests covering the changed privacy behavior.

options.title: Document Strict Churn As Expected
options.body: Keep the current strict behavior and document that room_event can change prompt/cache contracts when operators choose this configuration.

recommendation.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
recommendation.body: Keep room_event final text private by default, but pass a stable prompt-facing mode through all prompt, queue, and tool-list paths so cacheable prefixes do not churn.
